about: Whether a client accepts a hosted machine, for that project only: the client's account (me) and what it knows of the project's owners from its own checks (a team's roster and members' certificates, or its account's chain), never control's word for the machine. In this order: the certificate and delegation well formed and naming each other (form); the owners the client knows are the delegation's (wrong_project); me in the project (not_in_project); the delegation signed by a device, trusted now, of one of the project's owners, a browser, a CLI or the app (not a machine or a recovery code) (unsigned); the certificate signed with the key the delegation names (bad_signature); made no earlier than the delegation and before any revoke that checks out (by any owner, of this delegation) (revoked). Revokes that don't check out are ignored. Accepted, it gives the client's role in the project.
